## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:` ...)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; typecheck, lint and tests pass locally
- [ ] `docs/PRD.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Migrations (if any) are forward-only and safe on older instances
- [ ] No hard-coded name, colour, font or logo
